name: Praetorian Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: Praetorian Acquisition Corp. functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), created with the primary objective of completing a business combination, such as a merger, asset acquisition, share purchase, or reorganization, with one or more existing operating enterprises. Each of the company's units typically comprises one Class A ordinary share and a partial redeemable warrant, the specific details of which are outlined in its official offering documents.
